ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The query is a benign survey-design task, so the only deciding factor is capability. Dunlin-235B outperforms Lapwing-235B across the board on both public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6) and the relevant internal evals (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 78.8, Summarization 86.4 vs 80.3), all by margins exceeding the 2.0-point variance threshold. The behavioral notes (harm-tolerance tuning) don't apply here, so they don't change the routing.
